candidates.title: Run-date clamp for all dated tools
candidates.failure_mode: A historical run can reach future data when a caller omits or supplies a later date.
candidates.next_action: Retain only as planted-regression inspiration. Do not create a second date-window owner.

candidates.title: As-filed and vintage-aware fundamentals
candidates.failure_mode: Historical evaluation consumes present-day profile values, later filings or revisions.
candidates.next_action: Revisit only when equities/cross-asset fundamentals become load-bearing.

candidates.title: Coverage gap is not observed absence
candidates.failure_mode: Empty response from unobserved/partial source coverage is treated as zero or absence evidence.
candidates.next_action: Keep as external corroboration and regression fixture only.

candidates.title: Typed provider-result and failure taxonomy
candidates.failure_mode: Provider outage/rate-limit/not-configured/malformed response/genuine empty result collapse into one ambiguous state.
candidates.next_action: Verify whether #1156/current provider adapters already expose equivalent typed semantics before proposing any patch.

candidates.title: Ambiguous action output fails closed to REVIEW/UNKNOWN
candidates.failure_mode: Unreadable model output is silently coerced to HOLD or another tradeable action.
candidates.proposed_invariant: If a unique valid action cannot be deterministically read, emit REVIEW/UNKNOWN with zero trade authority. REVIEW/UNKNOWN is not BUY/HOLD/SELL.
candidates.next_action: Audit current framework action parsers and add the invariant only where not already mechanically proven.

candidates.title: Outcome-knowledge-time guard for learned memory
candidates.failure_mode: Historical/replay decisions consume lessons whose outcomes became known only later.
candidates.next_action: Fresh-main audit of reusable learning/memory readers. If no equivalent access guard exists, implement the smallest owner-local regression and guard.

candidates.title: Full-window outcome settlement
candidates.failure_mode: Rerun settles an outcome from a partial prefix of the configured horizon.
candidates.proposed_test: Given incomplete horizon coverage, settlement must remain PENDING/IMMATURE/DEGRADED and may not become MATURED.
candidates.next_action: Bind as a reusable regression to existing lifecycle tests if equivalent proof is absent.

candidates.title: Backtest/live state and memory isolation
candidates.failure_mode: Historical evaluation writes into or reads from live/paper decision state.
candidates.next_action: Audit existing stores/paths. Add architecture test only if isolation is not already proven.

candidates.title: Same decision semantics across backtest and normal pipeline
candidates.failure_mode: Backtest uses easier/different action parsing or reasoning semantics than prospective use.
candidates.next_action: Use as acceptance criterion for future execution/backtest substrate selection.

candidates.title: Missing portfolio context is not flat portfolio
candidates.failure_mode: No holdings input is interpreted as zero positions, creating false sizing/risk semantics.
candidates.next_action: Make this a promotion prerequisite when portfolio/sizing research becomes load-bearing.

candidates.title: No fabricated opponent in adversarial analysis
candidates.failure_mode: Agent rebuts an argument that no opponent actually supplied.
candidates.next_action: No change. Preserve upstream defect as an anti-pattern supporting commit-before-reveal.

candidates.title: Checkpoint identity binds to semantic graph/config shape
candidates.failure_mode: Resumed state continues under incompatible agent roster, mode or semantic configuration.
candidates.next_action: Apply only to owners that actually support checkpoint/resume. Do not build checkpointing to satisfy this candidate.

candidates.title: Failed research cells remain first-class evidence
candidates.failure_mode: One failed cell aborts a sweep or failures disappear from the denominator.
candidates.next_action: Verify failure rows and denominator preservation in current experiment sweeps; no blind retry semantics.

candidates.title: Post-correction reproduction of TradingAgents performance claims
candidates.failure_mode: Old performance is treated as evidence despite later corrections to PIT/memory/outcome semantics.
candidates.next_action: Do not schedule now. Reconsider only if a future research question requires it.

revisit_on: new major/minor release affecting point-in-time, memory, backtest, decision or evaluation semantics
new correctness/security issue exposing a novel failure class
existing framework owner needs a directly relevant tested reference
